name: Canvas UI Kit
subtitle: Native components. Live demos.
promotionalText: Explore 108 live components, expressive charts, and native Liquid Glass. Try five color palettes, light and dark themes, and layouts made for iPhone and iPad.
description:
Explore the Canvas component library, running natively on your iPhone and iPad.

Canvas is a hands-on reference for developers and designers. Browse 108 components, try their live examples, and see how native controls, expressive charts, and complete screen layouts fit together. Every example is built with the same library it documents.

A FRESH DESIGN, IN YOUR HANDS

Discover Canvas's new visual system: luminous surfaces, precise typography, thoughtful motion, and five accent palettes. Switch between violet, cyan, mint, rose, and amber; explore light and dark appearances; and experience native Liquid Glass on supported devices.

TRY THE REAL COMPONENTS

Tap buttons, change selections, adjust sliders, enter text, open sheets, and explore interactive charts. Live playgrounds make component options tangible, with code examples and prop references alongside the rendered result.

EXPLORE THE FULL LIBRARY

- Controls, inputs, navigation, overlays, and layout components
- Charts for trends, comparisons, distributions, and financial data
- Calendars, tables, lists, and other data-rich interfaces
- Complete templates and patterns that show components working together
- Color, typography, spacing, and other design foundations
- Search across the catalog to find the component you need

BUILT FOR iPHONE AND iPAD

The app runs as native views with iOS interactions and responsive layouts. It is a working showcase of @nannier/canvas, the React Native UI kit available on npm.

Canvas is free to use. No account, no sign-in, no ads, and no tracking.
whatsNew:
Canvas has a new look and feel.

- A complete visual redesign with luminous surfaces, refined typography, and thoughtful motion.
- Five accent palettes, light and dark themes, and native Liquid Glass on supported devices.
- An expanded catalog of 108 components, with richer charts, more icons, and interactive examples.
- Animated showcases that demonstrate how controls, inputs, navigation, data, charts, and overlays behave.
- Updated playgrounds, code examples, and layouts for iPhone and iPad.
reviewNotes:
Canvas is the reference app for the Canvas React Native UI kit. Every component example runs as a live native view. The app opens directly into its catalog and requires no account, sign-in, subscription, or purchase.

To review: launch the app, open Components, choose Button, Calendar, Slider, or a chart, and interact with the playground. Appearance controls let you change the color palette, light/dark scheme, and glass/solid surface mode.

Some templates demonstrate sign-in and sign-up layouts. They are UI examples only: they do not authenticate, create accounts, contact a login service, or unlock app content. No credentials are required. Sign-in required is intentionally unchecked.

This version introduces the Canvas v4 design and expanded component showcases. The screenshots show the iOS app on iPhone and iPad. Liquid Glass uses the system material where available and falls back on older supported systems.
